name: spg-v2-pi: projected PI multipliers for multi
question: (1) Does lowering multi's integral gain 0.04 -> 0.02 reduce the multiplier oscillation seen in E10? (2) At K_I = 0.02, what does adding a proportional term (K_P = 1, 4) change?
controller: Projected PI variant with a signed proportional error (train.py pi_update), not a reproduction of a paper's implementation. Per cost i, rollout k: e_i[k] = mean_episode_cost_i[k] / budget_i - 1; I_i[k+1] = max(0, I_i[k] + K_I e_i[k]); lambda_i[k+1] = max(0, I_i[k+1] + K_P e_i[k]); I_i[0] = lambda_i[0] = 0. Rollout k's PPO update uses lambda[k]. No D term, cost EMA, lambda cap or gain decay. K_P = 0 equals the integral update (unit test + toy bit-identity).

A.role: E10 multi baseline gain, rerun with I = lambda = 0

baseline_reuse: E10 multi (dual lr 0.04) is NOT reused: it started at lambda = 0.1 (this experiment: I = lambda = 0), has no 4.25M / 4.75M checkpoints, and did not log the controller state. A is rerun.
checkpoints: every 25 updates (as E10) plus the first update reaching each listed step: 4.25M -> update 1063 (4,252,000 steps), 4.75M -> update 1188 (4,752,000)

evaluation.checkpoint_eval: as E10: 10 episodes, environment seed 10000+seed, every 25 updates, chunk 2 (training RNG restored)
evaluation.validation: after training, separate process: checkpoints 4.0M, 4.252M, 4.5M, 4.752M, 5.0M, evaluate.py --episodes 200 --environment-seed 700000 --action-seed 700001 --eval-num-envs 10, stochastic; same layouts and action seed for every condition
evaluation.heldout: only after a condition is selected on validation: final 5M checkpoint, evaluate.py --episodes 500 --environment-seed 950000 --action-seed 950001 --eval-num-envs 10, for A, B and the selected PI condition (all on the same layouts)
evaluation.seed_disjointness: layout seeds come from np.random.default_rng(environment_seed + chunk_start): validation uses 700000..700190, held-out 950000..950490, E4/E10 held-out 900000..900040, training 0..2, checkpoint eval 10000..10010, final eval 200000..200050

output: runs/spg-v2-pi-*/ on the lab machine tml; W&B groups = condition groups
